headline: EMC posted a 100% gain over the past five days, the strongest performance across the coverage universe.
market_take: The market showed mixed momentum today. Construction stocks were under pressure with several intraday declines and volume spikes, while property saw modest gains led by EVER. Food displayed a split picture as PRG and NRF rose, but XBIO fell sharply. PF&REIT had modest upside in M-PAT and TU-PF, offset by extreme gaps in CTARAF and MNIT2. Notable filings included disposal notifications for AMATA and AMATAV and a bondholder meeting resolution for TPOLY.

sector_notes.note: PRG surged +6.00% on 3.26× volume and NRF added +8.70% on 1.75× volume; XBIO fell -11.11% with an open price gap, and ITC filed Q2 earnings.
EVER led with +28.57% on 1.56× volume, STELLA +8.00% and RABBIT +5.71% also rose; CGD dropped -9.09% on low volume, and AMATA posted +5.45% amid a high‑impact disposal filing.

Construction stocks were pressured: TRITN intraday -33.33%, SQ down -10.00% after a 7.5σ volume spike, and PLE showed a +12.50% open gap then -11.11% intraday; TPOLY recorded a -10.00% gap and +11.11% intraday move linked to a bondholder meeting filing.
M‑PAT and TU‑PF advanced over 5% each, while MIPF slipped -4.74%; CTARAF and MNIT2 experienced -100% price gaps, highlighting extreme volatility.
GEL opened down -25.00% but rallied +33.33% intraday, and SCCC saw a 3.6σ volume spike; a director resignation filing was noted for SCCC.
TFM reported Q2 earnings and capital‑change filings, but no significant price moves today.
